description: Look up an HTTP status code in the IANA registry, or search reason phrases. Pass exactly one of `code` (100–599) or `keyword` (e.g. "too many"). Returns the registered phrase, its class, defining reference with section, and whether it is temporary, obsoleted, or unused; an unassigned code returns found: false with the unassigned range it falls in.

code.description: Status code to look up, 100–599 (a digit string such as "429" also works). Pass this or keyword, not both.

keyword.description: Words matched as whole tokens against registered reason phrases, e.g. "too many" or "gateway". Pass this or code, not both.

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return, 1–100. Default 25.

offset.description: Number of keyword matches to skip; pass the next_offset of the previous response to get the next page. Default 0.

name: iana_lookup_http_status

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `mode_required`: Neither or both of code and keyword were given. `upstream_unreadable`: The HTTP status registry file could not be fetched or parsed. `pacer_shed`: This server's own iana.org request queue is too full for the call to start in time. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

found.description: True when a registered status matched.

next_offset.description: Pass as offset for the next page; absent on the last.

notice.description: Guidance on a miss, a cut list, or another condition.

source.description: Provenance and freshness of the answer.

fetched_at.description: ISO 8601 time of the last successful fetch or revalidation.

registry_id.description: Id of the registry file that answered.

registry_updated.description: The registry's own last-updated date; absent for the protocol index.

stale.description: True when a refresh failed and a cached copy up to 7 days old answered.

statuses.description: Matching status codes: exact phrase hits first, then registry order.

class.description: Status class from the first digit.

phrase.description: The registered description, with markers such as "(Unused)".

id.description: E.g. "RFC 9110", a draft name, a registry id, or a URL.

label.description: Label text, when it adds to id and section.

totalCount.description: Matches before the limit was applied.

truncated.description: True when more matches exist than were returned.

unassigned_range.description: For an unassigned code, the registry range it falls in, e.g. "432-450".

title: Look up an HTTP status code
